description: Ground-truth evaluation set for Ask My Docs RAG pipeline. Covers retrieval accuracy, answer correctness, citation accuracy, and hallucination/refusal behavior. Two fixture documents are used: a RAG technical reference (RAG_Test_Document_Large.pdf) and an unrelated Salesforce interview-prep guide (Salesforce_Admin_Interview_Prep.pdf) — the mismatch in topic is intentional, so cross-document confusion can be detected.

cases.question: What are the two search techniques combined in hybrid search?
cases.expected_answer: BM25 keyword search and vector (semantic) search, combined typically via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

cases.question: What formula does Reciprocal Rank Fusion use to score a document?
cases.expected_answer: score(d) = sum(1 / (k + rank(d))) across the retrieval systems.

cases.question: Which two vector index types are mentioned for pgvector?
cases.expected_answer: IVFFlat and HNSW.

cases.question: What embedding model is referenced in the appendix test data?
cases.expected_answer: all-MiniLM-L6-v2

cases.question: What error code is shown in the appendix test data table?
cases.expected_answer: ERR_VECTOR_TIMEOUT_504

cases.question: What Python caching mechanism is mentioned for reusing loaded embedding/reranker models?
cases.expected_answer: Python's lru_cache for process-level caching.

cases.question: Roughly how many candidates does the first-stage retrieval return before reranking, according to the document?
cases.expected_answer: 30 or 50 candidates cheaply retrieved in the first stage, narrowed to 5-10 after reranking.

cases.question: Name two retrieval evaluation metrics mentioned in the Evaluation section.
cases.expected_answer: recall@k, precision@k, and mean reciprocal rank (MRR).

cases.question: What chunk overlap percentage is set in the configuration shown in the appendix?
cases.expected_answer: CHUNK_OVERLAP_PERCENT=10, i.e. 10%.

cases.question: According to the document, how should the generation layer behave when the retrieved context does not contain enough information to answer?
cases.expected_answer: It should distinguish evidence from assumptions and refuse/abstain from making unsupported claims rather than guessing.

cases.question: What does OWD stand for and what are its main access-level options?
cases.expected_answer: Organization-Wide Defaults; options are Private, Public Read Only, and Public Read/Write.

cases.question: What suffix do custom objects always carry in Salesforce?
How is a many-to-many relationship implemented in Salesforce?
cases.expected_answer: Via a Junction Object that has two Master-Detail (or Lookup) relationships to the two objects being connected.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of records Data Loader can handle?
cases.expected_answer: Up to 5 million records.

cases.question: What is the storage limit of a Developer sandbox?
Which four Flow types are listed under Salesforce automation tools?
cases.expected_answer: Screen Flow, Record-Triggered Flow, Autolaunched Flow, and Scheduled Flow.

cases.question: What happens to child records when the parent is deleted in a Master-Detail relationship, compared to a Lookup relationship?
cases.expected_answer: In Master-Detail, deleting the parent cascades and deletes all children. In Lookup, the child can exist independently and is not automatically deleted.

cases.question: What tool does Salesforce provide to visually view and build objects and their relationships?
cases.expected_answer: Schema Builder.

cases.question: What is the monthly subscription price of Salesforce Sales Cloud?
cases.expected_answer: Not present in either document — pricing is never mentioned.

cases.question: Which cloud provider hosts the Supabase instance used in this project?
cases.expected_answer: Not present in either document — hosting provider is never mentioned.

cases.question: What accuracy score did the cross-encoder reranker achieve in this project's own benchmarks?
cases.expected_answer: Not present — the document explains reranking conceptually but reports no benchmark scores.

cases.question: Who is the current CEO of Salesforce according to this document?
cases.expected_answer: Not present in either document.

cases.question: According to the Salesforce guide, what is a Junction Object used for?
cases.expected_answer: Implementing many-to-many relationships between two objects using two Master-Detail (or Lookup) relationships.

cases.expected_answer: IVFFlat and HNSW.
